code_reasoning: Closed filename/schema/count checks prevent source inventory silently shrinking or expanding; exact source bytes and digests validated; INDEX retains both attribution statements and enumerates all texts. Metadata stays outside shipped assets.

Fd-relative O_DIRECTORY/O_NOFOLLOW traversal and nonblocking regular-file opens prevent symlink/FIFO traversal; before/after descriptor/path stat tuple rejects file replacement during reads; relevant content sizes bounded. iOS walk reads only notice contents, not unrelated app data.

ZIP preflight checks EOCD, actual central-directory entry count/length and byte ceiling before ZipFile metadata allocation; local/central names, method, size/CRC or descriptor checked; overlaps, duplicate/casefold-NFC aliases, unsafe paths, encryption/multipart/ZIP64 and unsupported compression refused.

Raw notice DEFLATE uses fixed output ceiling and complete EOF/no-unused-data/no-unconsumed-tail checks; forged-short output cannot conceal extra decompressed text. Direct byte equality is required beyond hashes. All26 notices must occur at intended Compose path.

Catalog CRLF-to-LF policy is explicit and records raw digest. Notice bytes never normalize; path-scoped git -text protects original CRLF. No Git runtime dependency, so copied no-Git root with explicit --root works.
